Scope: Static publisher-page, version, licensing, output-sensitivity and telephony-control review of MiTeC System Information eXtra and TAPI Monitor; no payload executed or host/phone data accessed

TermsPage.Observation: The current support EULA says unregistered/trial software is freeware for non-commercial use and lists named-user/build-machine, team, site and trial licenses. Product-specific paid options and local rights remain separate.

Products.Name: MiTeC System Information eXtra
Products.PublishedBehavior: Demonstration application based on the MiTeC System Information Component Suite. It provides system information and can save brief text, full XML reports and structured-storage files for later viewing. The published version history includes hardware/device, OS, storage, process, service, event-log, security and SMBIOS areas, but the precise contents/redaction of each report are not stated on the product page.
Products.LicenseObservation: The page calls the separate application freeware for private, educational and non-commercial use; this does not grant component-suite development or redistribution rights.
Products.Acceptance: Do not create, save, load or share reports from the development host or a real user profile. Any later report check must use a disposable guest with synthetic fixtures and an explicit field inventory; review redaction, storage and cleanup before retaining output.

Products.Name: MiTeC TAPI Monitor
Products.PublishedBehavior: Portable monitor for TAPI lines, telephones and TSP providers; displays TAPI messages and active-call details. Basic controls can make, answer, drop, redirect and transfer calls. Version history says 1.1.0 added TSP provider and line/phone configuration management. The publisher says it installs nothing and leaves no traces; this claim is not runtime-verified.
Products.LicensePagePriceObservation: The page lists a EUR 30 lifetime single-user license on the review date. The support EULA separately describes non-commercial unregistered use and license types; no local entitlement or redistribution conclusion is inferred.
Products.Acceptance: No real line, telephone, TSP provider, active call or call history may be inspected or controlled. If later needed, use a simulated non-production provider and synthetic calls; keep line/provider configuration unchanged and test only simulated call lifecycle/recovery.

MigrationDisposition.Resolved: Current versions, x86/x64 viewer/helper membership, report output surface, active call controls and publisher licensing boundaries are recorded.
MigrationDisposition.Partial: Report field sensitivity/redaction and component-suite rights remain unknown; TAPI provider/line/configuration effects, local entitlement, runtime and no-trace claims are unverified.
Deferred: Owner-specific MiTeC application/component use and redistribution assessment

Windows target, UI and activation behavior through an approved guest workflow
MigrationDisposition.EstimateReason: Sensitive output and telephony effects are better bounded, but rights and complete user-visible/runtime outcomes remain open; no estimate deduction is justified.
